attendee_and_staff.note: Non-management roles only see tiles relevant to their own supervision history and learning resources. Additional tile 'My Portfolio' (/portfolio) replaces restricted admin tiles.

retained_elements: Full meetings list with status badges (Draft, In Review, Signed Off, etc.)
Real-time search bar (by title, attendee name, location)
removed_elements: Due This Month matrix carousel (Schedule due-cards widget)
Top 3 summary stat cards (Total / In Review / Signed Off - optional header summary metrics available in filter bar if required)
meetings_page_simplification_spec.benefit_rationale: Removes data-fetch dependencies from the landing page. Renders instantaneously, prevents visual clutter on mobile/desktop, and turns the Meetings page into a focused execution stream.

due_this_month_and_overdue_banner_reloca.rationale: The 'Due This Month' widget and Overdue Actions banner are schedule-centric management controls, not meeting-execution tools. Placing them prominently at the top of /admin/schedules and /supervision-matrix aligns perfectly with workflow context (when managers are planning shifts & auditing compliance), while leaving /meetings 100% lean for recording and reading reports.
due_this_month_and_overdue_banner_reloca.user_invite_ack: User explicitly asked 'happy for you to suggest better ideas if you have them'. Relocating schedule-due widgets to the dedicated Schedules page keeps the landing tile hub lightning fast and meeting list clean.

supervision_matrix_enhancement.design: Clean button-style link: 'View Schedules' with Calendar icon and ChevronRight icon, positioned in top-right of Supervision Matrix header.

motion_and_interactions.tile_hover: transform transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg border border-gray-200 hover:border-[#1E3A8A]

accessibility.min_contrast: 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display elements
accessibility.keyboard_nav: All tiles and buttons tabbable with visible outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1E3A8A]
accessibility.screen_readers: aria-label attributes on icon buttons, role='region' for tile grid
accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory on all interactive elements using kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace existing Dashboard.js content with the 6-tile Bento shortcut hub layered inside <Layout>.
2. Move current meetings list code from Dashboard.js into a dedicated simplified Meetings component at route /meetings (updating App.js lazy route).
3. Add role-based filtering (user.role) so admin/manager see all 6 tiles while attendee/staff see only Meetings, Resources, and My Portfolio.
4. Create the new Resources page at /resources with instant-loading downloads and supervision course coming-soon cards.
5. Update SupervisionMatrix.js header to include top-right link to /admin/schedules.
6. Ensure all interactive tiles and buttons retain data-testid attributes for E2E tests.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: DO NOT use transition: all. Use specific properties (e.g. transition-transform, transition-colors).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.centering: DO NOT add text-align: center to the root App container.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.theme_color: Maintain brand color #1E3A8A as primary accent, with dark navy org bar.
